profile.headline: Director of Software Engineering | Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering
positions.description:
- Continued responsibilities of Software Engineering Manager, overseeing a diverse team of
engineers across multiple software disciplines.
- Led cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions, aligning product lines with strategic
business goals.
- Oversaw communications, requirements gathering, and project timelines, ensuring alignment
with company objectives.
- Evaluated emerging technologies and their potential alignment with the company roadmap.
- Managed internal teams and external contractors, coordinating efforts to meet tight project
deadlines.
- Orchestrated cross team collaboration in software, robotics, and firmware to deliver embedded
products aligning with company goals, increasing delivery of production speed by over 50%.
- Regularly presented project updates to executives, aligning engineering efforts with business
development needs and ensuring stakeholder satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Company subject matter expert for Xilinx Zynq-based platforms, specializing in Petalinux and
Vitis AI.
- Led development of software solutions for tamper resistance and exportability, ensuring
compliance with security standards.
- Spearheaded the software team's efforts through safety acceptance process, achieving
successful reviews and certifications.
- Recruited and onboarded 4 additional engineers, boosting team capacity and enabling faster
project turnaround, contributing to a 5.5x revenue increase.
- Acted as software product owner, guiding tasking, timelines, and workload distribution to
maximize team output.
- Mentored junior engineers and conducted performance reviews, fostering environment of
continuous improvement and learning to ensure career development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed safety-critical software for semi-autonomous targeting and weapons systems,
ensuring compliance with regulatory safety standards.
- Led integration of new hardware into existing software platforms, optimizing for seamless future
integration.
- Maintained and enhanced cross-platform codebases, supporting Windows, NVIDIA Jetson
platforms, and Xilinx Zynq SoCs (embedded Linux).
- Led the evaluation and prototyping of new technologies to align with company roadmap,
including making key decisions regarding adoption of Xilinx products.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Designing, coding and maintaining embedded flight software in primarily C / Assembly. Providing technical leadership to software team. Collaborating with other disciplines to develop drivers. Understanding customer requirements and their implications. Writing and maintaining related project documentation. Verifying flight and EM hardware. On orbit support.

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description: C++ development for test software on a project intended to go on a space shuttle; porting over software from previous code base to newly updated internal API; embedded development in C for same project working on embedded tests and reference driver code, interfacing with hardware/FPGAs. Direct interfacing with NAND flash.  Verifying and testing EM and flight hardware.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching assistant responsibilities, teaching CS to an international blind student, logistics, grading, and other activities to help Department Mentor be more efficient and effective

company.name: Department of Computer Science, Colorado State University

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description: Worked on adding functionality to the QEMU tool for LEON boards
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Systems · Code Review · Aerospace

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description: Working with build scripts and make files for projects intended for satellites, testing and researching cheaper alternatives to current software to reduce license consumption and costs to the company

positions.title: Studio Assistant
positions.description: Framing and handling fine artwork, packaging and cleaning, inventory, data entry, pricing, organizing files, customer service

volunteerExperiences.description: Working in the toddler and nursery rooms to provide childcare during church services; managing ~10 children on average and teaching them appropriate lesson plans and stories
Outreach services to the CSU campus; helping create a friendly and welcoming environment to any and all that are interested
